preview.what: Advanced relations: hasManyThrough, polymorphic, pivot data, morph maps.
preview.picture: Friend-of-a-friend links: hasManyThrough is 'countries → users → posts' in one step; polymorphic is one comments table that can point at posts, videos, or products.
preview.why: Modeling a real domain with relations is a common take-home.
preview.bn: hasManyThrough = বন্ধুর বন্ধু এক ধাপে, polymorphic = এক comments table যা post/video/product-এ যেতে পারে।
